configuration: A320-200 ceo CFM56; planning figures, not airline AFM dispatch data

approach.notes: Held out from coefficient generation. Full-flap CLmax is an engineering assumption, not solved from this figure.

landing.locator: 3-4-1 page 2, CFM56 sea-level curve; x-axis in pounds
landing.notes: Approximate visual reading near 145500 lb; actual distance equals 0.6 times field length. Simulation differences are reported, not relabeled as certified performance.

takeoff.locator: 3-3-1 page 2, CFM56 ISA sea-level curve near 141100 lb
takeoff.notes: Runway limitation incorporates certified operational assumptions. An all-engines simulator ground run is not an equivalent balanced field-length test. Report only until accelerate-stop/engine-out schedules are independently defined.

mmo.notes: Operating limit; not evidence for a drag/thrust map or economic cruise Mach.

vls_stall_ratio.notes: FAA A320-231 accident account describes Airbus normal-law concepts. It is a different engine variant and accident configuration: use only the documented control concept, never its numerical stall/alpha-protection speeds as A320-214 validation.
